result: Exact rmcp-v3.1.4 cancellation/input-required interaction pins an additional durable fence: cancel_task on a nonterminal task records cancel intent, signals cancellation, clears pending_inputs and recomputes status before acknowledgement. Therefore the old input_required payload is superseded at ack; a pre-terminal tasks/get may show Working or race directly to a terminal state, but must not keep the cleared input request authoritative. Clearing drops parked request_input senders, causing TaskExit::Cancelled; late tasks/update responses for cleared keys are ignored. A persistent restart design must durably bind cancel_requested plus input invalidation before ack, retain anti-reuse state, and generation/CAS-fence stale attempts from re-publishing superseded input. Cooperative terminal semantics remain operation-defined.
